graph.name: Innovaccer Healthcare Data Activation Platform
graph.categories: Healthcare, Big Data & Analytics, Patient Care Automation
graph.notes: Innovaccer's data activation platform ingests patient records from 500+ hospital facilities into Amazon S3, processes 20 billion records via EMR into Redshift and Neo4j for patient deduplication, syncs data into Aurora to serve 10,000 care providers via applications, and automates patient outreach using Amazon Connect.

nodes.name: HOSPITALS
nodes.notes: 500 different geographical facilities feeding EHR data with disparate data models

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Distributed object storage holding raw extracted EHR data, cutting previous SDFS storage costs by over half

nodes.name: EMR
nodes.notes: Runs data parsing, transformation, and massaging to normalize data into a unified canonical model

nodes.name: Neo4j
nodes.notes: Graph database correlation engine utilizing Levenshtein, weighted Levenshtein, and fuzzy matching algorithms for patient deduplication

nodes.name: REDSHIFT
nodes.notes: Central OLAP data warehouse holding canonical processed medical records

nodes.name: AURORA
nodes.notes: Operational data store synced from Redshift to power care provider applications

nodes.name: Apps
nodes.notes: Application layer serving care providers and triggering automated patient outreach workflows

nodes.name: CONNECT
nodes.notes: Triggers automated contact flows calling patients when medical intervention is required

nodes.name: CARE PROVIDER
nodes.notes: Doctors, care providers, and health coaches receiving 360-degree patient views and insights

edges.notes: Extracts EHR data from hospital systems and deposits into S3
EMR jobs pull raw EHR data from S3 for transformation
EMR writes processed canonical data into Redshift OLAP store
EMR pushes patient record data into Neo4j correlation engine for indexing and deduplication
Data is synced from Redshift into Aurora operational data store
Aurora serves operational query data to application backend
Apps trigger automated contact workflows in Amazon Connect when patient intervention is needed
Apps deliver 360-degree patient medical insights and workflow tools to Care Providers
